app_executable: python3 linux/benchlab.py --mode desk (GTK3, native Wayland; process name and app id BenchLab)
requires: Python 3.11 or later with PyGObject, GTK 3 and AT-SPI
Hyprland 0.55 or later with a Lua config, hyprland/bench.lua loaded (1920x1080)
the desktop user's Hyprland session environment
wlrctl (virtual-pointer protocol) or ydotool with ydotoold running, for the mouse user's clicks; without either UM-01 is a harness error
a screen of at least 1320x860 (the user window and its canvas)
